item.title: How a trade to the Ottawa Charge was like a family reunion for Brooke McQuigge
item.description: For Brooke McQuigge and her sisters, the PWHL couldn't have come at a better time. Now, all three are settled in Ottawa and hardly go a day without seeing each other.

item.title: Player grades: Tkachuk overtime penalty sinks Senators in inexcusable loss to Oilers
item.description: Ottawa captain Brady Tkachuk's holding penalty in extra time led to Evan Bouchard's game-winning power-play goal, Jake Sanderson had a rough defensive game, Drake Batherson had a second straight two-goal game, and Linus Ullmark wasn't good enough in a 5-4 loss.

item.title: ‘This is very much Carney’s deputy minister cadre’: PM shuffles top ranks of public service
item.description: Carney names BlackRock executive Glenn Purves deputy minister of international trade, continuing theme of pulling top execs from banking world.

item.title: Gary Bettman calls downtown arenas ‘economic engines’ as Senators inch towards finalizing LeBreton deal
item.description: NHL commissioner Gary Bettman spoke about the Ottawa Senators' planned new rink at LeBreton Flats.

item.title: Ottawa community advocate raises funds for cancer research, one laugh at a time
item.description: Jenny Chen has raised more than $22,000 for Laugh For The Cure, a fundraising campaign for research by the Ottawa Cancer Foundation.

item.title: Ottawa police looking for pregnant woman not seen since early February
item.description: Patricia Goulet-Cousineau, who frequents the 200 block of the Bronson Avenue area, has not been seen since early February, police said

item.title: Protesters rally against Iran war, defence spending in downtown Ottawa
item.description: Anti-war protesters and counter protesters squared off outside a defence conference at the Château Laurier.

item.title: Dear Rideau Canal Skateway: Thank you for a great skating season
item.description: There was something poetic about staying open for 56 days of skating in the Skateway's 56th season of operation.

item.title: What we're hearing about the Ottawa Senators with Friday's trade deadline approaching
item.description: Some of the defencemen the Ottawa Senators had targeted were either traded Wednesday or contemplating a move to another team
